# Insta Caption Generator

Insta Caption Generator is an AI-powered tool to instantly generate custom, engaging Instagram captions based on your desired topic, tone, format, and preferences.

## About

- Website: https://instacaptiongenerator.com
- Purpose: Help content creators and users write better Instagram captions faster using AI.
- Features: Support for different tones, languages, emojis, and hashtags. Includes history and quick copying.

This file provides context for LLMs interacting with the site.
